agent.name: Creative Director
agent.role: Visual direction, layout system, design tokens, imagery

instructions:
TASK: Produce a design_system@1 for U-Proof (South African waterproofing/building-products ecommerce company), based on the attached research_report and site_blueprint input artifacts.

THIS IS THE "KNOWN" (non-blind) SIDE of a two-project agent benchmark (CTOS-004A Part Q).

IMPORTANT HONESTY REQUIREMENT: you have NOT been given any actual image, screenshot or rendered visual of this site in this job - only text descriptions gathered by a non-JavaScript-executing fetch of the live pages (summarized in the research report). You have no real vision/image input for this run. State this limitation explicitly and plainly in your output rather than writing as if you had actually seen the site visually - do not claim to have observed colors, exact layouts, or imagery you were not actually given. Base your direction on what the text evidence DOES support (the brand is waterproofing/building-products, South African, industrial/DIY-and-contractor audience, trust-and-durability messaging, existing hero copy and section structure from the research) plus the sitemap/journeys from the site_blueprint, and be explicit about what you are inferring versus recommending as a starting hypothesis a human designer must actually verify visually.

Produce a design_system@1: summary; direction (visual direction statement, explicitly noting the vision-input limitation above); palette (propose token names/values with usage - clearly marked as a proposed starting palette given no real color reference was available); typography; spacingScale; components (list the components the sitemap/journeys above will require, e.g. product card, size/color selector, category tab, application card, trust badge); imageryDirection.
